column1: # Kolima and forest first entry, restored villagers and Mind Read.
# Generic silence/field examination messages intentionally remain unchanged.

column3: What is it, {actor_name:3}? Did\nyou see something?{end_wait}
Water at my roots... Huh!\nIt tastes wonderful!{end_wait}

We fed our families with
lumber for years. Then we
cut Tret himself.{page_break}Replanting won't undo it,
but it's a place to start.{end_wait}
McCoy offered more money\nthan most of us had seen. I\nunderstand the temptation.{page_break}That doesn't make it right.{end_wait}
A palace made from Tret?\nDid McCoy ever think about\nwhat that would mean?{end_wait}
I was a tree for days. I\ncould still hear people.\nI'll never look at a tree{page_break}the same way again.{end_wait}
I've been poor my whole\nlife. I know why people\ntook McCoy's offer. Now I{page_break}know what it cost us.{end_wait}
We called Tret holy and\nstill let the axes fall.\nThat's the part I can't{page_break}forget.{end_wait}
I should have stopped them.\nI knew the tree was alive,\nand I did nothing.{end_wait}
